verdict.rationale: BILL S&E's own cards are described as categorizing every transaction (docs-9, docs-68). The platform also offers budgets and transaction management (docs-2, docs-69) and real-time S&E event notifications (docs-3, docs-16), which points to transaction-level data being available as spend happens. However, nothing documents a founder-facing view of spend broken down by team, category, and merchant on the day it occurs. missing for 10: a documented real-time spend dashboard or reporting, explicit breakdowns by team/department and merchant, evidence that card transactions post same-day, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
